name: Magical Stone Excavation
extDescription: Discard 2 Cards from your hand. Add 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard to your hand.

name: Nimble Momonga
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, gain 1000 Life Points. You can also Special Summon up to 2 "Nimble Momongas" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

name: Magician of Faith
extDescription: FLIP: Select 1 Spell Card in your Graveyard. Add it to your hand.

name: Pyramid Turtle
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster with 2000 or less DEF from your Deck.

name: Smashing Ground
extDescription: Destroy 1 face-up monster with the highest DEF on your opponent's side of the field. (If it's a tie, you get to choose.)

name: Kuriboh
extDescription: Discard this card. Make the Battle Damage inflicted to your Life Points by 1 of your opponent's monsters 0. You can only use this effect during your opponent's Battle Phase.

name: Abyss Soldier
extDescription: Once per turn, by discarding 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard, return 1 card on the field to its owner's hand.

name: Ring of Destruction
extDescription: During your opponent’s turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls whose ATK is less than or equal to their LP; destroy that face-up monster, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK, then inflict damage to your opponent, equal to the damage you took. You can only activate 1 “Ring of Destruction” per turn.

name: Morphing Jar
extDescription: FLIP: Both players discard all cards in their hands. Then both players draw 5 cards.

name: Dark Master - Zorc
extDescription: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Contract with the Dark Master". During your Main Phase, you can roll 1 six-sided die. On a 1 or 2, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. On a 3, 4, or 5, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field. On a 6, destroy all monsters on your side of the field.

name: Magical Dimension
extDescription: Activate only while there is a face-up Spellcaster-Type monster(s) on your side of the field. Tribute 1 monster and Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand. Then you can destroy 1 monster on the field.

name: Happy Lover
extDescription: Enemies become overjoyed when struck by the Heart Ray emitted from the forehead of this tiny cherub.

name: Rush Recklessly
extDescription: Target face-up monster gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Ceasefire
extDescription: Flip all face-down Defense Position monsters on the field face-up. Flip Effects are not activated at this time. Inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each Effect Monster on the field.

name: Thunder Dragon
extDescription: During your Main Phase, by discarding this card, add up to 2 "Thunder Dragons" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
extDescription: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, Special Summon it during the End Phase of this turn with 1000 ATK and 1000 DEF. You can only use this effect once per Duel.

name: Book of Taiyou
extDescription: Flip 1 face-down monster on the field into face-up Attack Position.

name: Terraforming
extDescription: Add 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck to your hand.

name: Big Bang Shot
extDescription: The equipped monster gains 400 ATK. During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. When this card is removed from the field, remove the equipped monster from play.

name: Stray Lambs
extDescription: If you activate this card, you cannot Normal Summon, Flip Summon or Special Summon during this turn. Special Summon 2 "Lamb Tokens" (Beast-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position.
